about: Bundle budgets in KB gzipped, read by scripts/bundle-budget.mjs (npm run budget). Plan W6.26: they only go down. After each train `npm run budget:ratchet` lowers every budget to the measured size plus the margin when that is lower, never higher; `npm run pr:check` fails a diff that raises one, and `npm run budget:history` checks every commit of this file. A rule with `expires` is an exception: it names its task, and the budget fails once the date has passed. The first matching rule wins, so narrower patterns come first.

startup.note: C2: the SUM of what index.html loads before the app can run (its entry script + every modulepreload), not each file alone. Measured 448 KB (18.10); goal 250 KB (W4.9: 460 → 380 → 300 → 250).

rules.name: main bundle
rules.note: The eager Lumen runtime (App + side panels + i18n table). With Vite 8 the startup code shared by the HTML entries lives in app-*. History: 222 → 225 (round 16), 225 → 230 (round 25), 230 → 195 (audit M12-followup-2, rehype-raw lazy).

rules.name: entry stub
rules.note: The entry main-* is a stub with a tight budget of its own, so code moving back into it can't double the startup allowance.

rules.name: vendor: mermaid
rules.note: 800 → 860 (2026-10 dependency audit): mermaid 11.17.2 fixes five advisories; measured 833.3 KB on Linux. Lazy: only a doc with a mermaid block fetches it.

rules.name: vendor: shiki
rules.note: ~263 KB today; per-language grammars live in assets/shiki-langs/* and are fetched on demand.

rules.name: vendor: react
rules.note: Bundles react and react-dom (round 16); splitting them caused a circular-import init crash.

rules.name: vendor: excalidraw-mermaid
rules.note: Excalidraw's Mermaid → diagram dialog (plan 4.19), loaded on demand.

rules.name: vendor: excalidraw core
rules.note: Exception. Excalidraw's own core module (dist/prod/chunk-EIO257PC, 0.18.1) is one file no chunk grouping can split: 718.6 KB on verify/train (11.11.2026). Decision 11.11: a rule of its own at measured + 3%, never a blanket raise. Lazy (canvas only), not precached. A new Excalidraw build renames the stem, falls to the 700 rule and fails: decided again, not inherited. W1.36 looks for a smaller build and removes this rule; when it expires the budget fails until it is lowered or decided again.

rules.name: vendor: modelviewer
rules.note: @google/model-viewer + three.js, self-hosted (CSP bans the CDN); only a ```model3d block loads it.

rules.name: lazy: pdfjs
rules.note: The pdfjs-dist text extractor, only on PDF import; its worker ships as a separate .mjs.

rules.name: lazy: prettier
rules.note: Standalone core + one chunk per language plugin; the TypeScript parser is 204 KB with Vite 8.

rules.name: lazy: cytoscape
rules.note: mermaid's graph layouts, split out of vendor-mermaid.

rules.name: lazy: ts checker
rules.note: TypeScript compiler + lib .d.ts for the opt-in code-block checks (src/lsp); one worker, not precached. Measured 1325 KB (TypeScript 5.9).

rules.name: lazy: web-llm worker
rules.note: web-llm with its inlined tokenizer wasm and TVM runtime: 2082 KB (0.2.82). Only on the first in-browser AI prompt, never precached.

rules.name: lazy: transformers worker
rules.note: transformers.js (local Whisper + embeddings); the ONNX Runtime wasm is served from public/ort/.

rules.name: lazy: graphviz worker
rules.note: viz.js wasm in its own worker so the page CSP needs no unsafe-eval (~608 KB).
